title: AC1021 TABLESTYLE source/output handle preallocation fix
scope: Reproduce and fix an AC1021 TABLESTYLE/STYLE output-handle collision in a locally generated control; do not enable physical AC1021 TABLESTYLE output from this control alone.

control.origin: Created locally from scratch in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp for the specific collision control; no DWG/DXF fixture file was committed.
control.tableStyleReference: The generated TABLE points to the unique TABLESTYLE source handle; its legacy row styles name TABLE_FONT.
control.fixtureNormalization: Non-merged cells use unit span values so the TABLE serializer reaches the handle-identity assertions.

baseline.result: FAIL at record-inventory finalization: duplicate emitted handle 0x701 for STYLE and TABLESTYLE.
baseline.cause: fileExport moved m_tableStylesToEmit into dxfRW before writeTables; the later adapter preallocation loop therefore saw an empty selection. The unbound TABLESTYLE source identity could alias the next TEXTSTYLE record handle.

implementation.change: Retain the adapter's selected TABLESTYLE handles when registering TABLE code-342 validation, and preallocate fallback and extension TABLESTYLE handles before TEXTSTYLE table-record handles are minted.
implementation.failClosed: Any failed or ambiguous preallocation still aborts the write before destination publication.

verification.generatedAsciiBinaryControl: PASS: --tablestyle-source-output-identity-collision; both encodings reimport with distinct TABLESTYLE/TEXTSTYLE handles, three TABLE_FONT row-style names, and three typed legacy rows.
verification.existingFastCtests: PASS: libdxfrw_dxf_tables_write_inspection and libdxfrw_table_content_dwg_object_roundtrip (2/2, 0.21 seconds total). The TABLESTYLE collision control is also invoked for ASCII and Binary by the existing table-writer inspection cohort.

nextAction: Apply the corrected identity preallocation to the exact selected projection of existing AC1021 lineweights.dwg. Preserve immutable STYLE/TABLESTYLE/dictionary source baselines; require ASCII and Binary output/readback, bad-reference atomic refusal, same-adapter correction/retry, and unchanged strict whole-source refusal. Keep the AC1021 support gate closed until that physical-source proof passes.
qualificationLimits: Generated adapter consistency is not independent producer evidence.
This does not qualify the AC1021 physical TABLESTYLE source, its complete dependency graph, native semantics, the architectural CELLSTYLEMAP profile, or whole-document output.
No support claim or version allowlist was changed.
